stem: What is the most likely reason the poet uses this imagery in the poem?
instruction: Read lines 12 and 13 from the poem “Out Where the West Begins.”

options.label: A
options.text: To show that the rivers of the West are wide

options.label: B
options.text: To suggest that the people of the West work hard

options.label: C
options.text: To suggest that the West makes people happy

options.label: D
options.text: To show that the West offers different activities

visual_elements: Where there’s laughter in every streamlet flowing, Where there’s more of reaping and less of sowing,
